item.title: [IMANI Center for Policy and Education --Ghana] Apache2 Ubuntu Default Page: It works
item.description:
Apache2 Default Page
It works!
This is the default welcome page used to test the correct
operation of the Apache2 server after installation on Ubuntu systems.
It is based on the equivalent page on Debian, from which the Ubuntu Apache
packaging is derived.
If you can read this page, it means that the Apache HTTP server installed at
this site is working properly. You should
replace this file
(located at
/var/www/html/index.html
) before continuing to operate your HTTP server.
If you are a normal user of this web site and don't know what this page is
about, this probably means that the site is currently unavailable due to
maintenance.
If the problem persists, please contact the site's administrator.
Configuration Overview
Ubuntu's Apache2 default configuration is different from the
upstream default configuration, and split into several files optimized for
interaction with Ubuntu tools. The configuration system is
fully documented in
/usr/share/doc/apache2/README.Debian.gz
. Refer to this for the full
documentation. Documentation for the web server itself can be
found by accessing the
manual
if the
apache2-doc
package was installed on this server.
The configuration layout for an Apache2 web server installation on Ubuntu systems is as follows:
/etc/apache2/
|-- apache2.conf

item.description:
IEA Ghana
Evidence for Ghana’s Democratic and Economic Transformation
Independent public policy research and dialogue by the Institute of Economic Affairs, advancing evidence-based solutions for Ghana’s development.
About IEA
Our Work
About Us
Institute of Economic Affairs (IEA) Ghana
The Institute of Economic Affairs is Ghana’s premier public policy institute, established in 1989 to advance democratic governance, economic transformation, institutional effectiveness, and informed public discourse.
Over the years, the Institute has earned a strong reputation as a respected and independent voice in Ghana’s public policy landscape. Its work is grounded in analytical rigour, intellectual independence, constructive engagement, and a deep commitment to national development.
About IEA Ghana

Our Work
IEA Ghana explores key policy issues shaping Ghana’s development through research, dialogue, and evidence-based engagement.
